rules.statement: A person cannot acquire prescriptive title without demonstrating an overt act showing an intention to possess adversely to the owner.
rules.supporting_quote: Without any demonstration of any overt act against the rights of the owner, court cannot recognize Nandasekera as a person who has acted as one holding prescriptive possession against the owner who had given him leave and license to step in and live there, no matter how long he had enjoyed the property.
